title: Is AI Bubble Waiting To Burst? Nikhil Kamath Warns Of Tougher Months Ahead
hook_before: Nikhil Kamath warns investors about a potential AI bubble.
script:
Billion dollar bets on AI might be failing. Nikhil Kamath predicts tougher months for companies.
He predicts tougher months ahead for companies betting heavily on this tech.
Kamath points to the massive capital flowing into these unproven business models.
Public interest in AI tools remains high, but real revenue growth is lagging.
Previous tech cycles often crashed when valuations decoupled from actual earnings.
Kamath suggests current AI hype mirrors past market bubbles that eventually popped.
Do you think current AI stocks are overpriced?
